ITA-10.3.1 dinacaryā दिनचर्या
Daily routine
A term covering activities related to diet, lifestyle, work and recreation from the time an individual wakes up through to sleep: it is prescribed in accordance with natural diurnal rhythms and their impact on the human body and mind based on the person’s age, place of habitation and seasonal cycle.

ITA-5.11.9 dinapāki-ajīrṇam दिनपाकि-अजीर्णम्
Indigestion, when food takes a full day to get digested
